verdict.rationale: The evidence documents an Admin API with programmatic access to all resources, plus an llms.txt and an MCP server, but none of these is a downloadable machine-readable API spec. No item mentions an OpenAPI or equivalent spec file. Having an API, or an llms.txt docs index, is adjacent to the story and does not deliver it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
